Recorded claim:
D210809 explicitly praised meaningful descriptions added to existing test_accountMgr2 assertions and asked that the numeric-hostname test say "hostname 2" to avoid reading "2 hostnames". The landed test names expected account, server, identity, and URI lookup results. For account-manager tests, include the property or lookup result in assertion text; this is review-backed test wording, not a formatter rule.
